name: g3_r4
prereg: R4 TrPLet-like top-k (12 candidates), nested per-gene selection by inner 3-fold grouped CV. Coverage rule (docs/g3_nonlinear_results.md): the *_probe run (fold 0, first 30 genes of configs/g3_variable_subset500.csv) is timed first; the full config runs if the projected 5-fold wall time is <= 2 h, otherwise the *_sub500 config. The leaky oracle run uses the same coverage.
